Name: (CP) Harvey's New Moustache
Author: TeaLovingLad
Description:
This mod addresses a personal gripe I've had for who-knows-how-long:
[b]Harvey's poor excuse of a moustache[/b], which looks more like a permanent coffee stain he got from drinking too much coffee!
In comparison to all the other bearded villagers, Harvey has by far the most underwhelming beard of them all. [i](Even your grandpa's ghost has a better beard than him!)
[/i]
This content pack will overlay my personal rendition of Harvey's new, twirl-worthy moustache over his portraits. Should you use portrait
replacement mods that only make slight changes to Harvey, then there is a chance that the moustache might still fit![i]

[/i]I'm aware that [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10607]Harvey's Better Moustache[/url] exists, but I wanted to make my own take on it. Whether you choose this mod or Harvey's Better Moustache is up to your preference!


[center]
[size=5][b]Requirements
[/b]
[size=3]See the [b]"Requirements"[/b] section at the top of this description.[/size][/size][/center][size=5]

[center][size=5][b]Compatibility
[/b]
[size=3]Harvey's New Moustache has full compatibility support for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17059]Diverse Stardew Valley - Seasonal Outfits (DSV)[/url]﻿'s Vanilla/Lightweight Config, thanks to the help of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/70148453]Airyn[/url]﻿![/size][/size][/center]
[/size]


[center]
And that would be all! Thank you for at least considering to download/endorse this mod.

[b]Now go on and have a good one of whatever you feel like!
﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿[color=#00ffff]- Tea-Loving Lad[/color][/b][/center]

Downloads.Description:

Now with proper version number, so that SMAPI stops telling you to update this mod.
